name: Azeroth Companion
title: REAL MAP FIRST — No Blank Atlas, Real Game-Derived Maps & Actionable Points of Interest
approval_note: Owner requested usefulness and actual map content instead of repetitive planning workflows. Direct sourced WoW zone map imagery replaces art as the first Atlas experience. Map files remain externally hosted and copyright credited; external availability and real-game tests are separate.
features: Atlas now opens directly to a GAME-DERIVED Retail zone map (Hallowfall by default) rather than fantasy art or an empty coordinate grid; seven selectable Khaz Algar/Dragon Isles map references.
Documented dungeon, raid, delve, flight path, landmark and quest markers appear over the real image with source-backed X/Y/map IDs; select a pin or search/filter to find a location instantly.

Copy an actual WoW user-waypoint macro in one action, zoom and drag the game map, open the full external source for complete map databases, and show clear fallback links if external map hosting blocks an image.

Previously saved personal coordinate pins appear on the actual game-derived map in a separate Personal style; all original Atlas route planning and decorative field guides remain preserved as optional archival sections.
The Command Center and Gateway now describe the accurate game map experience, not stale illustrative art.
No changes to Blizzard authentication, saved goals/builds/routes, Cloudflare Worker, Private Video Vault, sitewide Unity navigation or older functionality.
